subject: Trial qualification check-in: success criteria, ownership, procurement readiness
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@sagehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: draft trial plan & initial success criteria

Thanks again for the call this morning — great context on the inference use case for clinical notes classification. As promised, I’m attaching a one-page draft of the trial plan (trial-plan-draft.xlsx) and a short set of proposed success criteria to get us moving. Summary below: 

High-level objective:
- Validate parity on accuracy for our model on your de-identified notes and ensure 95%+ precision on the top predicted labels for the 6 priority workflows.

Proposed success criteria (draft):
- Accuracy/precision targets per workflow (see attached)
- Latency SLA: 95th percentile < 250ms for single-request inference during mimic load (peaks ~20 rps)
- Throughput: sustained 1,000 tokens/sec across the trial window for batch ingestion
- No PII leakage in logs; evidence of KV/prefix caching working for repeated patient lookups

Key asks from SageHealth for POC kickoff:
1) Infra access: a short-lived VM or private endpoint to validate connectivity (idempotent test payloads)
2) Security: completed SOC2 questionnaire + ATO checklist (we’ll share template)
3) Procurement timeline & PO contact so we can align SOW timing

Suggested timeline:
- Week of May 3: infra smoke tests and security evidence exchange
- Week of May 10: seeded trial (10k records) and initial metrics readout
- Two-week trial window following seed to validate metrics and run runbooks

Ownership (initial suggestion):
- Redwood infra & runtime: Marcus Lin (capacity, kernel config)
- Integration & app-level routing: Ben Carter (API keys, routing policy)
- Security/compliance liaison: Kimberly Park (questionnaire, encryption, logs)
- Customer procurement: Emily + Tom (procurement lead)

Please review the attached and the criteria. If these look reasonable, I’ll publish a simple RACI and circulate internally for sign-off. 

Attachments: trial-plan-draft.xlsx (outline, test dataset spec)

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
From: Emily Park <emily.park@sagehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@healthprocure.com>, SageHealth IT <it@sagehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: draft trial plan & initial success criteria

Thanks Olga — the summary captures our needs well. Couple of clarifying points from procurement and IT: 

Procurement timeline:
- Procurement (PO + SOW review): target week of May 10–14. Our legal wants a short SOW that limits data residency exposure for the trial (we can sign for a 30-day trial). Tom Alvarez (cc’d) is our procurement lead — he’ll coordinate the paperwork.

Security & infra:
- IT can provide a VPNed test endpoint for inbound traffic and a temporary service account. We’ll need a short security questionnaire back from Redwood for our security team to clear before we hand over any de-identified records.
- For the trial we prefer Redwood to run in your hosted environment (no on-prem required) but we need assurances around logs and retention.

Success criteria feedback:
- Precision target looks good; could we also include a per-workflow recall floor (we’d like recall >= 85% for the top 3 workflows).

Next steps for us:
- I’ll confirm the PO cadence by COB Monday (May 3).
- Tom, please confirm if a standard PO via Ariba works or if you need a DocuSign SOW.

Attachment: sagehealth-eval-criteria.pdf (internal priority workflows + sample golden labels)

Best,
Emily Park
Director, Analytics Platforms | SageHealth
emily.park@sagehealth.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Proposed RACI for SageHealth trial (please confirm)

Team — Emily confirmed procurement and preferred hosted deployment; Tom will drive PO/SOW. I sketched a concise RACI below so we can respond fast. Please reply with any objections or updates by EOD Monday.

RACI (proposed):
- Connectivity & endpoint setup:
  - Responsible: Ben Carter
  - Accountable: Olga Petrov
  - Consulted: Marcus Lin, SageHealth IT
  - Informed: Kimberly Park

- Capacity & performance tuning (latency/throughput):
  - Responsible: Marcus Lin
  - Accountable: Marcus Lin
  - Consulted: Ben Carter
  - Informed: Olga Petrov

- Security questionnaire & evidence (SOC2 snippets, logging configs, retention period):
  - Responsible: Kimberly Park
  - Accountable: Kimberly Park
  - Consulted: Marcus Lin
  - Informed: Ben Carter

- Trial evaluation & metrics tracking (dashboards, alerting):
  - Responsible: Ben Carter
  - Accountable: Ben Carter
  - Consulted: Olga Petrov, SageHealth Analytics
  - Informed: Marcus Lin

- Procurement & SOW execution:
  - Responsible: Emily Park / Tom Alvarez (SageHealth)
  - Accountable: Olga Petrov (to sign Redwood’s trial SOW after PO)
  - Consulted: Kimberly Park
  - Informed: Ben Carter

Notes / implementation details:
- Marcus: recommend starting with a 16g GPU pool with autoscale-to-24g for the seeded run; we’ll enable prefix caching and a 30-minute KV TTL. Let me know if you want me to create a short test plan for perf runs.
- Kimberly: prepare the short SOC2 excerpt packet plus our log retention policy doc (2 weeks by default) so we can send to SageHealth IT.
- Ben: set up a trial dashboard template in the console (per-route latency & token counts) and a CSV ingestion runbook.

Attachment: raci-proposal.csv (simple table version)

Thanks — once we have confirmations I’ll send a single consolidated note to Emily/Tom with the SOW link and proposed kickoff date.

— Olga
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Proposed RACI for SageHealth trial (please confirm)

+1 from me. Marcus — can you validate the 16g->24g autoscale plan (esp memory for kv cache) and confirm the perf run windows this week? I’ll prep the dashboard and ingestion playbook Monday.

Quick note for Emily (to be included in the customer-facing consolidated email): we’ll seed with 10k de-identified records for the first run, then run a second sweep with 50k if the initial metrics look stable. That gives you the per-workflow recall/precision curves quickly.

— Ben
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@sagehealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@healthprocure.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: SageHealth trial: final plan, ownership & SOW link

Emily / Tom — thanks for the quick responses. Per internal confirmations, please find the final plan summary and next steps below. I’ve attached the SOW (SOW-trial.pdf) and included a DocuSign link for a short 30-day trial SOW if that matches your procurement path.

Finalized ownership (customer-facing):
- Redwood point of contact (commercial/coord): Olga Petrov
- Integration & routing: Ben Carter (setup & dashboarding)
- Runtime capacity & perf: Marcus Lin (tuning & autoscale)
- Security/compliance liaison: Kimberly Park (evidence packet)

Proposed kickoff date: May 9 (smoke tests May 9–10; seed run May 11–12; two-week validation window thereafter)

Action items for SageHealth:
1) Confirm PO cadence (Tom) — is Ariba or DocuSign preferred? If DocuSign, use this link: https://docusign.com/s/SAGE-REDWOOD-SOW-2027 (temp link)
2) Provide VPN endpoint and temporary service account to our infra team (email it@sagehealth.com)
3) Send golden labels sample for initial seed (5k–10k) — security/redaction already discussed

Attachments: SOW-trial.pdf

Quote of Emily’s point for traceability:

> 
> Thanks Olga — the summary captures our needs well. Couple of clarifying points from procurement and IT...

If this all looks good I’ll ask Marcus to schedule a perf window and Ben to provision the trial dashboard (Monday). Tom — confirm procurement channel and I’ll route the SOW accordingly.

Thanks,
Olga
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
